lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Gray waves crash on the jagged stone
I walk the shoreline all alone
The salt is heavy in the air
I find the ghosts of prayers I share
[Pre-Chorus]
The lighthouse beams begin to sway
The clouds turn heavy, cold, and gray
[Chorus]
The tide pulls secrets from the deep
Promises that I meant to keep
The anchor holds against the gale
My heart is steady, my spirit's sail

I watched the ships sail out to sea
Lost in the mist of memory
I traded gold for moments of grace
The lines of time upon my face

One turning wave can set things right
